We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have a template (id 29646) that seems to deprotect TBS? Actually retro_smarts shows breaking O-Si bond to give OH. The template appears to convert a TBS-protected alcohol to free alcohol. The product is target with TBS? Wait product_smiles in template is the target (with TBS?) Let's examine: product_smiles: '[CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7]/[CH:8]=[CH:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[OH:14])[CH2:15][C@H:16]([OH:17])[C@H:18]1[CH3:19])[CH2:20][OH:21]'

That product has no Si. So template is deprotection: reactant_smiles includes Si. Indeed reactant_smiles: 'CC(C)(C)[Si](C)(C)[O:17][C@H:16]1...' So applying template to target (which is product) gives precursors with TBS protected? Wait apply_template with target returns possible precursors (reactants). The result gave three possible precursors: each with TBS group on different OH? Let's view first: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". That's target with TBS on the carboxylic acid? Actually O[Si] attached to carboxylic acid? The SMILES shows ...C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C meaning TBS ester of acid. Another precursor has TBS on the primary alcohol? second: "...C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" TBS on primary alcohol. Third: "...C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C" TBS on secondary alcohol.

Thus we can plan 5 steps: maybe start from simpler fragments: a cyclohexane diol core with side chain unsaturated acid etc.

We need 5 reactions: likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (reverse of template) but in retrosynthesis we go from target to precursors, so first step could be removal of TBS (i.e., apply template to get TBS-protected precursor). Then subsequent steps: maybe HWE to install side chain double bonds and acid; DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde then HWE; etc.

We need to propose route and output JSON with reactions and template IDs. We have only one template ID known (29646). Need other template IDs for other transformations: e.g., Still-Gennari (Z-HWE) template, DIBAL-H reduction, TBS protection, etc. We need to search for templates matching criteria.

Let's search for DIBAL-H reduction: functional_groups_broken: ["carboxylic esters"], functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"] maybe.
